newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan April first 10 day domestic WPI up 1.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Japan April first 10 day domestic WPI up 1.9 pct.

text.p: Japan's domestic wholesale price index (WPI), a key component of the overall WPI, rose 1.9 percent in the first 10 days of April from the previous 10-day period and was up 1.9 percent from a year earlier, the Bank of Japan (BOJ) said on Friday.
In the April interim period, the overall WPI was up 1.5 percent from the previous 10-day period and was up 3.1 percent from a year earlier.
The rise in the domestic WPI reflected the effects of an increase in the national sales tax rate on April 1 to five percent from three percent, the BOJ said in a statement.
